# Chemist and Druggist

> > Leading UK pharmacy news and information source covering clinical services, professional regulation, and pharmacy practice developments.

Chemist and Druggist (C+D) is the primary trade publication for community pharmacy professionals in the United Kingdom, providing breaking news, regulatory updates, clinical guidance, and professional conduct information. The publication covers essential topics including Pharmacy First services, emergency contraception protocols, and regulatory compliance for pharmacists and pharmacy teams.

## Key Topics

- Pharmacy First (PF) service
- Clinical pharmacy services
- Professional regulation and conduct
- Emergency contraception
- Community pharmacy practice
- National pharmacy campaigns
- Pharmacist warnings and disciplinary actions
- Pharmacy ethics and professional standards
- NHS pharmacy services
- Pharmacy service promotion
- Regulatory compliance
- Patient care protocols

## Clinical Services & NHS Pharmacy

- [Pharmacies must 'promote' PF service via national campaign](https://www.chemistanddruggist.co.uk/news/clinical/pharmacies-must-promote-pf-service-via-national-campaign-VWTJPLW2FJC67EL6GTYDLUWC4M/): CPE announces national campaign for pharmacies to promote Pharmacy First
